Solo Sprint Reality Check: the solo sprint covers Days 1–10.
Ten days is tight for Days 1–10: it compresses roughly two weeks of 5-person work into one person.
Two strict principles make the solo sprint (Days 1–10) survivable: Ruthless Scope Discipline and Never Cut Invariants.
Ruthless Scope Discipline: solo phase builds the thinnest possible vertical slice that proves the architecture.
Solo phase covers one category.
Solo phase covers one marketplace's rules.
Solo phase covers a handful of rule checks.
Solo phase covers one real LLM call.

Never Cut Invariants: never skip tenant isolation to hit Day 10 exactly.
Never skip schema correctness to hit Day 10 exactly.
Retrofitting tenant scoping under live traffic is 10x more expensive than spending an extra half-day getting it right initially.
Migrating schema under live traffic is 10x more expensive than spending an extra half-day getting it right initially.

Batch Import Resilience example: a user uploads a CSV with 500 rows.
Each CSV row is parsed individually.
Each CSV row fans out into async jobs in Redis+ARQ.
A malformed row never fails the batch.

The batch completes with a per-row summary report.
